verdict.rationale: Airwallex provides Card Expenses API to retrieve approved expenses and mark them synced after ingesting into an ERP/accounting system, plus webhooks and Bills API for AP, which supports expense/transaction syncing workflows via custom integration. However, there is no evidence of pre-built, native connectors to popular accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite) or an automatic out-of-the-box sync — it's API/developer-driven rather than a turnkey accounting integration. missing for 10: named native accounting-software connectors (QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite), evidence of automatic (no-code) sync setup, and independent confirmation of real-world reconciliation accuracy.
